name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_currency_destination_20260803_102624_553858
sql:
/* 红钻(10009)/晶钻(10206)消耗去向：按账号+事件秒与商店购买、技能抽卡、伙伴抽卡对齐；其余列为未归因。 */
WITH Cfg AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' ts,DATE '2026-08-02' te,DATE '2026-05-08' ss),
TB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp,c.u FROM SC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SC c JOIN SA a ON c.u=a.u),
Currency AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT) sec,
        REDUCE(FILTER(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=10009 AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)),0.0,(s,x) -> s+ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(x.diff AS DOUBLE),0)),s -> s) red,
        REDUCE(FILTER(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=10206 AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)),0.0,(s,x) -> s+ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(x.diff AS DOUBLE),0))/100.0,s -> s) gem
 FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
 WHERE e."$part_event"='item_change' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT),
        REDUCE(FILTER(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=10009 AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)),0.0,(s,x) -> s+ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(x.diff AS DOUBLE),0)),s -> s),
        REDUCE(FILTER(e.a_rst,x -> TRY_CAST(x.id AS BIGINT)=10206 AND TRY_CAST(x.before AS DOUBLE)>TRY_CAST(x.after AS DOUBLE)),0.0,(s,x) -> s+ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(x.diff AS DOUBLE),0))/100.0,s -> s)
 FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
 WHERE e."$part_event"='item_change' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te),c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL),
Actions AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT) sec,CASE WHEN e."$part_event"='skill_get' THEN '技能抽卡' WHEN e."$part_event"='Companion_get' THEN '伙伴抽卡' WHEN e."$part_event"='shop_buy' AND e.shop_item[1].shop_id>10000 THEN '晶钻商城' WHEN e."$part_event"='shop_buy' THEN '红钻商城' END destination FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c LEFT JOIN TB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event" IN ('shop_buy','skill_get','Companion_get') AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ts AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.te AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
 UNION ALL SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",CAST(TO_UNIXTIME(CAST(e."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AS BIGINT),CASE WHEN e."$part_event"='skill_get' THEN '技能抽卡' WHEN e."$part_event"='Companion_get' THEN '伙伴抽卡' WHEN e."$part_event"='shop_buy' AND e.shop_item[1].shop_id>10000 THEN '晶钻商城' WHEN e."$part_event"='shop_buy' THEN '红钻商城' END FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Cfg c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u WHERE e."$part_event" IN ('shop_buy','skill_get','Companion_get') AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.ss AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.ts,c.te),c.ss) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL),
Joined AS (SELECT c.grp,c.aid,c.red,c.gem,COALESCE(a.destination,'其他/未归因') destination FROM Currency c LEFT JOIN Actions a ON c.grp=a.grp AND c.aid=a.aid AND c.sec=a.sec WHERE c.red>0 OR c.gem>0)
SELECT grp "对比组",destination "消耗去向",COUNT(DISTINCT aid) "消耗人数",ROUND(SUM(red),0) "消耗红钻",ROUND(SUM(gem),2) "消耗晶钻",ROUND(100.0*SUM(red)/NULLIF(SUM(SUM(red)) OVER(PARTITION BY grp),0),2) "红钻消耗占比(%)",ROUND(100.0*SUM(gem)/NULLIF(SUM(SUM(gem)) OVER(PARTITION BY grp),0),2) "晶钻消耗占比(%)" FROM Joined GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,4 DESC,5 DESC;
